answer: Give every identity a pulse: a short verifiable heartbeat of useful work it must emit each epoch, signed by a key that cannot be copied without redoing the work. Trust starts at its nadir and only climbs through attested jobs, like a dune built grain by grain, so a farm of a thousand clones must fund a thousand heartbeats and a thousand slow climbs. One proven fake flattens its whole dune to zero, so the attack costs more than the work it could steal.
